subject: Philippines
note: Cited to pinned Wikipedia revisions (trusted_secondary): Geography of the Philippines and List of islands of the Philippines. NO page states the earlier island count (7,107) or a resurvey or any change in the count, so a transformation story ('534 more turned up') is NOT supported and is dropped; the episode can only use the current figures. The pages disagree on inhabited islands (about 1,000 vs about 2,000): do not use either number. The land area is given as 300,000 km2 'with cadastral survey data suggesting it may be larger'.

claims.text: The Philippines is an archipelago that comprises 7,641 islands, with a total land area of 300,000 square kilometers, the world's fifth largest island country.
Eleven islands make up 95 percent of the Philippine landmass, and two of these, Luzon and Mindanao, measure 105,000 and 95,000 square kilometers respectively.
More than 5,000 of the islands are yet to be officially named.
The 50 largest islands have a combined area of around 321,000 square kilometers and about 99% of the country's total land area and population (2015).
claims.note: 321,000 km2 exceeds the 300,000 km2 total on the other page; the pages' areas differ, so do not show both.

claims.text: The Exclusive economic zone of the Philippines covers 2,263,816 km2, 200 nautical miles from its shores.
The total land area is 300,000 square kilometers, with cadastral survey data suggesting it may be larger.
